title: 48-item Symptom Questionnaire
reference: © LUMC, Department of Psychiatry. Carlier et al. (2012) Psychiatry Research, 200(2-3), 904-910.
instruction: Try to answer the following propositions fairly and accurately. Give the answer that best expresses the number of times you have felt the following ways last week, including today.
workStudyNote: If you did not work or study or have not been able to do so, you can skip the work/study questions.

questions.text: I was short of breath with minimal exertion.
I felt weak or slow.
I was irritable and dissatisfied.
I felt anxious while I was in a crowd.
I felt palpitations.
I had trouble making decisions.
I could not enjoy anything at all.
questions.personalizationTemplate: Thinking about things you enjoy, like {hobby} — how often did you feel you could not enjoy anything at all?

questions.text: I did not dare to cross open spaces, such as a public square.
I felt stressed at my work or study.
I argued with others.
I felt chest pain or pressure.
I looked forward to things.
questions.personalizationTemplate: Did you look forward to activities like {hobby} this past week?

questions.text: I considered my death or suicide.
I did not dare to travel on my own using public transport.
I was dissatisfied with my work or study.
I was hot-tempered without good reason.
I felt dizzy or lightheaded.
I felt like doing things.
questions.personalizationTemplate: How often did you feel like doing activities you enjoy, such as {hobby}?

questions.text: I did not want to live anymore.
I had the feeling that I have been working or studying very hard.
I had trouble with controlling my anger.
I felt a tingling, for example in my hands.
I could hardly express myself.
I was afraid or anxious.
I did not dare to go alone to a crowded shop.
I was shaking or trembling.
I was afraid of rejection by others.
I was scared.
I was optimistic about my future.
I worked or studied less intensely than before.
I felt shaky or I had shivers.
I felt low and less than others.
I felt jittery and nervous.
I looked forward to my plans and goals for the future.
I had the feeling that I did not do well with my work or study.
I felt uncomfortable when other people looked at me.
I took interest in things.
questions.personalizationTemplate: How often did you take interest in your usual activities, like {hobby}?

questions.text: I felt hopeless.
I was forgetful.
I felt down or depressed.
I felt restless.
I felt energetic and high-spirited.
questions.personalizationTemplate: How often did you feel energetic enough to do things you enjoy, like {hobby}?

questions.text: I wanted to hit people if I was provoked.
I struggled to get the day started.
I felt insecure in the company of others.
I felt tense.
I could not concentrate well.
I worried.
